name: MonarchFieldRenderer
title: FieldRenderer
wrapsNative: A when over MonarchFormFieldType to MonarchFormField with MonarchTextField, MonarchNumberInput, MonarchSelect, MonarchRadioRow, MonarchRatingPicker and MonarchFileUpload; MonarchMultiSelect, MonarchCheckboxGroup and MonarchCheckboxRow; androidx.compose.material3.DatePickerDialog and androidx.compose.material3.TimePickerDialog for dates and times
summary: Renders one form question from data: the right Monarch input for its type, with the label, help, required mark, error and an optional “filled in automatically” note.
whenToUse: Questions are authored by admins and stored as data, or a form shows answers that were filled in automatically and people must check them.
whenNotToUse: When the form is fixed in code, compose MonarchFormField, MonarchTextField and the other inputs directly.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchFieldRenderer(field: MonarchFormFieldDefinition, value: MonarchFormFieldValue?, onValueChange: (MonarchFormFieldValue?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, problem: MonarchFormFieldProblem? = null, errorText: String? = null, confidence: Float? = null, confidenceThreshold: Float = 0.6f, labels: MonarchFieldRendererLabels = MonarchFieldRendererLabels())

public class MonarchFormFieldDefinition(id: String, type: MonarchFormFieldType, label: String, description: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, required: Boolean = false, options: List<MonarchFormFieldOption> = emptyList(), minLength: Int? = null, maxLength: Int? = null, min: Double? = null, max: Double? = null, minDate: Long? = null, maxDate: Long? = null, minSelections: Int? = null, maxSelections: Int? = null, accept: List<String> = emptyList(), maxFileSize: Long? = null, maxFiles: Int = 1, consentText: String? = null, conditions: List<MonarchCondition> = emptyList(), conditionMatch: MonarchConditionMatch = MonarchConditionMatch.All, readOnly: Boolean = false) { fun problem(value: MonarchFormFieldValue?): MonarchFormFieldProblem?; fun isVisible(values: Map<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>): Boolean }
public enum class MonarchFormFieldType { ShortText, LongText, Email, Phone, Url, Number, Date, Time, Select, MultiSelect, Radio, Checkboxes, YesNo, Consent, Rating, File, Section }

public sealed interface MonarchFormFieldValue { val isEmpty: Boolean; val raw: Any; data class Text(text: String); data class Number(number: Double); data class Date(millis: Long); data class Flag(checked: Boolean); data class Values(values: List<String>); data class Files(files: List<MonarchFormFieldFile>) }

public sealed interface MonarchFormFieldProblem { data object Required; data object MustAgree; data object Email; data object Url; data object NotANumber; data class Min(min: Double); data class Max(max: Double); data class MinLength(min: Int); data class MaxLength(max: Int); data class MinSelections(min: Int); data class MaxSelections(max: Int) }
public data class MonarchFormFieldOption(value: String, label: String)
public data class MonarchFormFieldFile(name: String, size: Long? = null, file: MonarchPickedFile? = null)

public class MonarchFieldRendererLabels(required: String? = null, mustAgree: String? = null, email: String? = null, url: String? = null, number: String? = null, min: ((min: String) -> String)? = null, max: ((max: String) -> String)? = null, minLength: ((min: Int) -> String)? = null, maxLength: ((max: Int) -> String)? = null, minSelections: ((min: Int) -> String)? = null, maxSelections: ((max: Int) -> String)? = null, yes: String? = null, no: String? = null, choose: String? = null, chooseDate: String? = null, chooseTime: String? = null, confirm: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, aiFilled: String? = null, aiCheck: String? = null, remove: String? = null, removeFile: ((name: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: field
options.description: The question: its type, label, help, required flag, options, limits, conditions and read-only flag.

options.name: value
options.description: The current answer, or null for none.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new answer; null when it is cleared.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the answer can be changed.

options.name: problem
options.description: A problem from MonarchFormFieldDefinition.problem, shown as the error with its built-in message.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message, such as a server error; replaces the message of problem.

options.name: confidence
options.description: The confidence, from 0 to 1, of an answer filled in automatically; shows a note under the question.

options.name: confidenceThreshold
options.description: The confidence under which the note asks people to check the answer.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings and messages.

states.name: empty
states.description: The input shows its placeholder, Choose…, Choose a date or Choose a time.

states.name: answered
states.description: The input shows the answer: text, the chosen option, a date such as Nov 14, 2026, a time, a rating or the chosen files.

states.name: error
states.description: The message shows under the question in the danger color and is the error of the input for TalkBack.

states.name: filled in automatically
states.description: With confidence, a note says the answer was filled in; below the threshold it asks for a check in the warning color.

states.name: read-only
states.description: Text questions keep a readable, read-only input; other questions are disabled.

states.name: section
states.description: A heading with an optional description and no input.

appearance: Every question uses the look of the Monarch input it renders: outlined fields with the input border, radio and checkbox rows, buttons for date and time. Errors use the danger text color, the automatic-fill note the AI text color or, when unsure, the warning text color; section descriptions use the muted text color. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from the color roles.
platformNotes: Same question types, checks, order of checks and default messages as the web (validateFormField is MonarchFormFieldDefinition.problem, which returns a typed problem; the renderer turns it into the message, and errorText replaces it). Differences: a date answer is UTC epoch milliseconds, as the Material 3 DatePickerState gives it, where the web stores YYYY-MM-DD; a time stays HH:MM. Dates and times are buttons that open the Material 3 DatePickerDialog and TimePickerDialog instead of typed inputs. File limits are MIME types and bytes (accept, maxFileSize) as in MonarchFileUpload, where the web takes an accept string and megabytes. A rating uses the numbered scale of MonarchRatingPicker because Monarch bundles no star glyph. The rows of a long-text question are not applied: MonarchTextField grows with its text. A consent shows no visible required mark; its error explains it. headingLevel and locale are not parameters: TalkBack has no heading levels, and the locale comes from the configuration. The AI note is text without the web's assistant glyph. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: Inputs without a label of their own sit in a MonarchFormField, so TalkBack reads the label, Required and the error on the input, and a new error is announced through a polite live region.
Multi-select and checkboxes questions use the labels, required marks and errors of MonarchMultiSelect and MonarchCheckboxGroup.
Radio and yes-or-no options are selectable 48dp rows in a selectable group; a consent is one checkbox row with its statement as the name.
A consent error is text under the row, announced through a polite live region, and is set as the error of the row.
Each chosen file has a 48dp remove button named Remove followed by the file name.
The automatic-fill note is text, not only color.
edgeCases: Text is cut at maxLength while typing; problem also reports a stored answer that is too long.
Spaces alone are no answer, and length checks ignore spaces at either end, as on the web.
A yes-or-no question with an answer that is not a Flag counts as unanswered.
Use isVisible to leave out questions whose conditions do not hold; the renderer does not hide itself.
A time answer that is not HH:MM shows Choose a time.

    MonarchFieldRenderer(
        field = form[0],
        value = answers[form[0].id],

val form = listOf(
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.0.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.0.type|pascal}}, {{fields.0.label}}, required = {{fields.0.required}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.1.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.1.type|pascal}}, {{fields.1.label}}, description = {{fields.1.description}}, required = {{fields.1.required}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.2.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.2.type|pascal}}, {{fields.2.label}}, options = listOf(MonarchFormFieldOption({{fields.2.options.0.value}}, {{fields.2.options.0.label}}), MonarchFormFieldOption({{fields.2.options.1.value}}, {{fields.2.options.1.label}}))),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.3.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.3.type|pascal}}, {{fields.3.label}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.4.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.4.type|pascal}}, {{fields.4.label}}),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.5.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.5.type|pascal}}, {{fields.5.label}}, required = {{fields.5.required}}, consentText = {{fields.5.consentText}} + "*"),
)
val answers = remember {
    mutableStateMapOf<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>({{prefilled.field}} to MonarchFormFieldValue.Text({{prefilled.value}}))
}
examples.setup:
val form = listOf(
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("name", MonarchFormFieldType.ShortText, "Full name", required = true),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("email", MonarchFormFieldType.Email, "Email", description = "We only use it to reply.", required = true),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("where", MonarchFormFieldType.Radio, "Where will you join from?", options = listOf(MonarchFormFieldOption("remote", "Remote"), MonarchFormFieldOption("office", "Office"))),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("relocate", MonarchFormFieldType.YesNo, "Can you relocate?"),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("rating", MonarchFormFieldType.Rating, "How was the process?"),
    MonarchFormFieldDefinition("consent", MonarchFormFieldType.Consent, "Consent", required = true, consentText = "I agree to be contacted about this request." + "*"),
)
val answers = remember {
    mutableStateMapOf<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>("name" to MonarchFormFieldValue.Text("Alex Morgan"))
}
